'''S'teeni''' was a type of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[biot]]. They were a kind of tree that looked as if they were dipped in [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. In [[43 ABY]], s'teeni were still present on the [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] [[Tandun III]]. However, they were destroyed shortly later when the planet exploded.
